rows.question: What is name of the country that speaks the largest number of languages?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH country_language_summary AS (
  SELECT
    CountryCode AS CountryCode,
    COUNT(DISTINCT trim(Language)) AS language_count
  FROM countrylanguage
  WHERE Language IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(Language) <> ''
  GROUP BY CountryCode
)
SELECT
  c.Name AS Name,
  cls.language_count AS LanguageCount
FROM country c
JOIN country_language_summary cls
  ON c.Code = cls.CountryCode
ORDER BY cls.language_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Give the name of the nation that uses the greatest amount of languages.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
JOIN (
  SELECT CountryCode, COUNT(DISTINCT Language) AS distinct_language_count
  FROM countrylanguage
  GROUP BY CountryCode
) lc ON c.Code = lc.CountryCode
ORDER BY lc.distinct_language_count DESC
LIMIT 1
